title: Jellyfish reading a book
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- jellyfish dome -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="32" rx="26" ry="18" fill="#FF7EB6"/>
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="30" rx="22" ry="14" fill="#FFB3D6"/>
  <!-- dome spots -->
  <circle cx="38" cy="26" r="3" fill="#FF5EA8"/>
  <circle cx="50" cy="23" r="3" fill="#FF5EA8"/>
  <circle cx="62" cy="26" r="3" fill="#FF5EA8"/>
  <!-- dome bottom rim -->
  <path d="M24 34 Q50 46 76 34 Q76 40 50 44 Q24 40 24 34Z" fill="#E84A8F"/>
  <!-- tentacles -->
  <path d="M34 40 Q30 52 34 62 Q38 70 33 78" stroke="#FF9BC9" stroke-width="4" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <path d="M44 42 Q42 54 46 64 Q50 72 45 82" stroke="#FFB3D6" stroke-width="4" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <path d="M56 42 Q58 54 54 64 Q50 72 55 82" stroke="#FF9BC9" stroke-width="4" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <path d="M66 40 Q70 52 66 62 Q62 70 67 78" stroke="#FFB3D6" stroke-width="4" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <!-- eyes on the dome -->
  <circle cx="42" cy="32" r="3.5" fill="#3A1A4A"/>
  <circle cx="58" cy="32" r="3.5" fill="#3A1A4A"/>
  <circle cx="43.2" cy="30.8" r="1.2" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  <circle cx="59.2" cy="30.8" r="1.2" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  <!-- little smile -->
  <path d="M46 37 Q50 40 54 37" stroke="#3A1A4A" stroke-width="1.6" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <!-- book -->
  <rect x="30" y="56" width="40" height="26" rx="3" fill="#4FC3F7"/>
  <rect x="48" y="56" width="3" height="26" fill="#2A8FC4"/>
  <rect x="33" y="59" width="13" height="20" rx="1" fill="#E8F7FF"/>
  <rect x="52" y="59" width="15" height="20" rx="1" fill="#E8F7FF"/>
  <!-- book text lines -->
  <line x1="36" y1="64" x2="44" y2="64" stroke="#9AD4F0" stroke-width="1.5" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <line x1="36" y1="68" x2="44" y2="68" stroke="#9AD4F0" stroke-width="1.5" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <line x1="36" y1="72" x2="42" y2="72" stroke="#9AD4F0" stroke-width="1.5" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <line x1="55" y1="64" x2="64" y2="64" stroke="#9AD4F0" stroke-width="1.5" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <line x1="55" y1="68" x2="64" y2="68" stroke="#9AD4F0" stroke-width="1.5" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <line x1="55" y1="72" x2="61" y2="72" stroke="#9AD4F0" stroke-width="1.5" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <!-- tentacles holding book -->
  <path d="M34 40 Q24 50 31 58" stroke="#FF9BC9" stroke-width="4" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <path d="M66 40 Q76 50 69 58" stroke="#FF9BC9" stroke-width="4" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <!-- tiny heart above -->
  <path d="M68 20 Q68 16 72 16 Q76 16 76 20 Q76 25 72 28 Q68 25 68 20Z" fill="#FF3D71"/>
</svg>
